{{Quote|In the same flight, one HT-2200 can carry cryogenic bio-samples and zero-G crystalline chips.|The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-D20]] describes the HT-2200|<ref name="ABGTAS">{{JournalCite|5|A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships}}</ref>}}
'''Zero-G crystalline chips''' were a type of cargo available during the existence of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. A [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[HT-2200 medium freighter]] was capable of carrying both zero-G crystalline chips and cryogenic bio-samples at the same time due to the fact it contained four separate cargo bays, each of which could be programmed for different environmental settings.<ref name="ABGTAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zero-G crystalline chips were first mentioned in [[1995]] in the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplemental books for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]]. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]].<ref name="ABGTAS" />
